title: Finite locally constant pullback on each pulled-back stratum
statement: Given a stratification S of X and a constructible abelian étale sheaf E whose set pullback to every S-stratum is finite locally constant, the set pullback of the abelian inverse image along g to every stratum of S.pullback g is finite locally constant.

proof.text: Pull back the witnessing étale covers along g, use inverse-image composition and restriction comparisons, constant-sheaf pullback, stalk-germ bijections, and the algebraic-structure comparison to transport finite local constancy.

mathlib_searches.query: finite locally constant étale sheaf pullback on pulled-back stratum

lean.statement:
theorem finiteLocallyConstant_pullback_stratum
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X)
    (E : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (S : Stratification X)
    (hS : ∀ i : Fin S.n, IsFiniteLocallyConstantEtaleSheafOfSets
      ((etaleSetPullback (S.immersion i)).obj
        ((sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology
          (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj E))) :
    ∀ i : Fin S.n, IsFiniteLocallyConstantEtaleSheafOfSets
      ((etaleSetPullback ((S.pullback g).immersion i)).obj
        ((sheafCompose Y.smallEtaleTopology
          (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj
          ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).obj E)))
